verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is that Radar Sessions let you capture fraud signals without tokenizing on Stripe. That hints at some flexibility in how Radar sits alongside a non-Stripe stack. Nothing shows Radar screening payments processed by other PSPs, gateways, or platforms; every other doc assumes Stripe charges, Stripe reviews and the Stripe Dashboard. Missing for 10: documented support for screening transactions on non-Stripe processors or gateways, multi-PSP integration docs, and independent confirmation of processor-agnostic use.
